repo_notes.content: SPICE GUI is a local-first desktop application built with SvelteKit 5 (Svelte 5 runes), Tauri v2, and a Rust backend under src-tauri/. It combines a gene/cloning workbench, a protein design and MD workbench, a project hub, and seven bench-analysis tools. Document the shipped application in this repository; do not pull architecture from the separate spice_engine or model-training repositories except where this app calls into them.
repo_notes.author: SPICE GUI maintainers

repo_notes.content: Use the project's vocabulary consistently. The five top-level user areas are Welcome (/), Protein workbench (/protein), Gene workbench (/gene), Project hub (/project), Bench tools (/tools), and Settings (/settings). SPD means the public SPICE Protein Database at d.spicebio.top. A SPICE_PROJECT document is the in-app project model; .spiceproj is its binary on-disk container; .spiceg and .spicep are standalone gene and protein documents.
repo_notes.author: SPICE GUI maintainers

repo_notes.content: Prefer source files over generated output. src/lib/paraglide/ is generated by Paraglide and must not be edited directly; message sources are project.inlang/messages/{zh,en,ja,ko,de,nl,sv}.json with Chinese as the source catalog. Ignore node_modules, build/, target/, pnpm-lock.yaml, src-tauri/Cargo.lock, and plan documents when describing behavior.
repo_notes.author: SPICE GUI maintainers

repo_notes.content: Scientific and algorithmic code is split by layer. TypeScript domain logic lives in src/lib/genome/ (sequence, enzymes, cloning, primers, CRISPR, alignment, biophysics) and src/lib/tools/*/ (gel, blot, qPCR, plate, colony, annotate, tree). Native compute lives in src-tauri/src/: onnx.rs for fold inference, spice.rs for SPICE Engine MD calls, cloning.rs for sequence and database operations, gel.rs for native gel binarization, spd.rs for the HTTP bridge, and files.rs for save dialogs. Tests mirror these areas under tests/ and e2e/.
repo_notes.author: SPICE GUI maintainers

repo_notes.content: Describe the current code and be honest about status. The protein folding model is still under development and is not bundled with this repository; the UI must report missing-model and untrained-head states rather than inventing predictions. Where the app depends on an external service, describe both the desktop path and the browser/demo fallback.
repo_notes.author: SPICE GUI maintainers

repo_notes.content: The README is the product-level source of truth for user-facing capabilities, while code and tests are authoritative for behavior. When a feature's documentation and implementation disagree, document the implementation and flag the mismatch instead of restating the README.
repo_notes.author: SPICE GUI maintainers

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Explain the overall system: SvelteKit routes and shared libraries, the Tauri IPC boundary, the Rust modules in src-tauri/src/, local-first data flow, and how the five user areas plus Settings fit together. Start from README.md's architecture diagram, then verify it against src/routes/, src/lib/, and src-tauri/src/lib.rs.

pages.title: Frontend Runtime and Browser Demo Mode
pages.purpose: Document the SvelteKit application shell, route structure in src/routes/, Svelte 5 runes state, and the browser fallback layer in src/lib/backend/api.ts and src/lib/backend/demo.ts. Explain how pnpm dev runs without Rust, a model, or an engine, and which Tauri commands degrade to local demo behavior.

pages.title: Tauri Command Layer and Native Modules
pages.purpose: Document how the webview invokes Rust: the command registration in src-tauri/src/lib.rs, typed wrappers in src/lib/backend/, and the responsibilities of onnx.rs, spice.rs, spd.rs, cloning.rs, gel.rs, and files.rs. Include the request/response types and error conventions that cross the IPC boundary.

pages.title: Application Shell, Navigation, Settings, and Identity
pages.purpose: Document src/routes/+layout.svelte, the workspace switcher and page identifiers, the welcome page cards in src/routes/+page.svelte, and settings in src/routes/settings/+page.svelte. Cover themes, language switching, keyboard shortcut editing, model status and download, ORCID identity in src/lib/identity/, database sync controls, and SPD connection settings.

pages.title: Internationalization and Localization
pages.purpose: Document the Paraglide setup: source catalogs in project.inlang/messages/, Chinese as the source locale, the strategy configured in vite.config.js and package.json scripts, generated output in src/lib/paraglide/, and how Rust emits i18n codes resolved by the frontend. Explain the workflow for adding a user-visible string across all seven locales.

pages.title: Protein Workbench Overview
pages.purpose: Document src/routes/protein/+page.svelte as the protein workstation: its menu structure, analysis tabs, draggable column layout, sequence and environment inputs, and how fold inference, MD verification, mutation tools, and export share state. Note that the SPICE Model is still under development.

pages.title: Fold Inference Pipeline
pages.purpose: Document the ONNX fold path end to end: sequence tokens and environment normalization in src-tauri/src/onnx.rs, model discovery and downloading, the multi-head outputs (reference C-alpha trace, mutation probabilities, design coordinates, environment offset, stability confidence, distogram), and post-processing in the protein route. Cover trained-head status reporting and missing-model behavior.

pages.title: MD Verification with SPICE Engine
pages.purpose: Document the all-atom MD workflow backed by src-tauri/src/spice.rs: building systems from PDB, mmCIF, or C-alpha coordinates, optional NVT equilibration, stepping, temperature changes, bias-force injection, coordinate clamps, metrics m1-m5, the live potential-energy trace, and the 2D RMSD versus radius-of-gyration landscape. Explain native state held in spice.rs and the frontend controls that call it.

pages.title: Stability Scans and Mutant Screening
pages.purpose: Document temperature-by-pH stability scanning, cooperative-collapse/Landau analysis, mutation ranking and the mutation cart, solvent-reuse mutant rebuilds, and high-throughput CSV variant screening. Point to the protein route sections and any helpers they use for GRAVY, charge, pI, helix propensity, disorder, and thermostability scoring.

pages.title: Structure Import and Molecular Viewer
pages.purpose: Document PDB/mmCIF import, RCSB fetch, PDB-REDO comparison, ligand-site annotation, Mol* integration in src/lib/viewer/MolStarViewer.svelte, viewer presets, and export of mmCIF and .spicep packages. Explain src/lib/backend/mmcif.ts and the structure conversion paths shared with the MD engine.

pages.title: Gene Workbench Overview
pages.purpose: Document src/routes/gene/+page.svelte as the DNA workbench: the FILE, EDIT, CLONING & DESIGN, ANALYSIS & VIEWS, and WINDOW menus, tab layout, workspace state, undo/redo, activity log, and the split between the route-level orchestrator and components in src/lib/gene/. Note its derivation from TeselaGen Open Vector Editor and what was integrated.

pages.title: DNA Editing and Map Rendering
pages.purpose: Document the sequence and map layer: src/lib/gene/SequenceRow.svelte, SequenceMinimap.svelte, SequenceToolbar.svelte, CircularMapCanvas.svelte, LinearMapCanvas.svelte, PlasmidMap.svelte, selection and clipboard tools, virtual keyboard, sequence search, feature editing, and the rendering helpers in src/lib/gene/utils/. Explain coordinate conventions and selection state.

pages.title: Cloning, Assembly, and Enzyme Catalogs
pages.purpose: Document restriction enzymes and cloning: src/lib/genome/enzymes.ts and digest.ts, REBASE synchronization and local caching, enzyme cut-set presets, methylation awareness, src/lib/gene/CloningSimulator.svelte and CloningValidator.svelte, the assembly methods in src/lib/genome/cloningMethods.ts and cloningValidation.ts, Golden Gate and recombinase methods, and DNA end modification.

pages.title: Primer, PCR, and Sanger Workflows
pages.purpose: Document primer design and validation in src/lib/genome/primerAnalysis.ts and tm.ts, the PrimerTable and primer LIMS panels, PCR simulations for standard, overlap-extension, and site-directed mutagenesis, virtual gel output, and Sanger trace import and validation through src/lib/genome/sangerTrace.ts and SangerChromatogram.svelte.

pages.title: Genome and Biophysics Analysis Panels
pages.purpose: Document the analysis panels under src/lib/gene/panels/ and their calculation modules in src/lib/genome/biophysics/: protein properties and structure, RNA folding, GC windows, fusion-frame checks, ribosomal frameshifting, advanced genomics, sequence evolution and alignment, codon optimization, reverse translation, silent mutagenesis, and reaction calculators. Include which operations call Rust.

pages.title: NGS, CRISPR, and Synthetic Biology
pages.purpose: Document the advanced gene-design panels: FASTQ QC and trimming, ORF prediction, CRISPR array finding, CRISPR design in src/lib/genome/crispr.ts, synthetic-biology CAD and SBOL/BioBrick/MoClo validation, codon design, synthetic-gene QC, and biosecurity screening. Trace each panel to its TypeScript logic and, where applicable, the Rust command that performs the computation.

pages.title: Gene Import, Export, and Documents
pages.purpose: Document gene data interchange: GenBank, EMBL, FASTA, FASTQ, SnapGene, GFF3/GTF/BED, NCBI/Ensembl/UniProt imports, auto-annotation with UniVec and Smith-Waterman, sequence collections, and .spiceg document loading, saving, dirty state, autosave, and crash recovery. Cover src/lib/genome/formats.ts and the file and import helpers in the gene route and Rust backend.

pages.title: Project Hub and SPICE_PROJECT Containers
pages.purpose: Document src/routes/project/+page.svelte and src/lib/project/: the SPICE_PROJECT data model, the SPJB binary .spiceproj container and legacy JSON import in container.ts and codecs.ts, embedded documents, attached files, project registry, localStorage session snapshots, and save/open flows in store.svelte.ts and fileIo.ts.

pages.title: Journal, Presenter Mode, and ELN
pages.purpose: Document the Markdown journal, page metadata, and Presenter mode in src/lib/project/PresenterView.svelte and slides.ts, including the slide grammar (headings, horizontal rules, quote blocks as speaker notes), audience and presenter views, keyboard controls, and fullscreen. Also document the gene workbench ELN pages, ORCID signing, audit trail, and report export.

pages.title: Workspace Document Handoff
pages.purpose: Document how the project hub captures and reopens live workspace documents: ProjectDocBanner.svelte, the handoff mechanism in the project store, the commit effects and tab guards in the gene and protein routes, dirty tracking, Ctrl+S behavior, and how bench tools register as project documents through src/lib/tools/shared/projectBridge.ts.

pages.title: Bench Tools Platform
pages.purpose: Document the shared foundation for all seven tools under src/lib/tools/: the /tools hub route, common project bar and storage, sample and plate vocabulary in shared/samples.ts, batch workers, canvas and preview helpers, project document bridging, reproducibility ZIP export, and the file layout convention each tool follows.

pages.title: Gel Figure Analysis and Detection
pages.purpose: Document the gel tool in src/lib/tools/gel/: image pipeline and display transforms, detection presets and configuration in presets.ts, lane/band detection in detect.ts, native binarization through src-tauri/src/gel.rs and native.ts, marker ladder fitting, figure composition, export formats, and folder batch processing. Explain the separation between detection state, display state, and figure state.

pages.title: Western Blot Densitometry
pages.purpose: Document src/lib/tools/blot/: image import and preprocessing, lane and band detection, ROI editing, background models, normalization, replicate statistics and confidence intervals, saturation flags, annotated figures, CSV export, project persistence, and batch quantification. Trace the quantitative model in quant.ts and stats.ts.

pages.title: qPCR Analysis
pages.purpose: Document src/lib/tools/qpcr/: CSV/TSV parsing and column mapping, Delta-Delta-Ct and standard-curve modes, multiple reference targets, efficiency correction, QC flags, well-level statistics, heatmaps and charts, plate-map integration, export formats, and project persistence. Trace calculations through analysis.ts and stats.ts.

pages.title: Plate Layout and Colony Counting
pages.purpose: Document the plate designer in src/lib/tools/plate/ (formats, sample import, seeded assignment, constraints, painting, sample sheets, qPCR plate maps) and the colony counter in src/lib/tools/colony/ (segmentation, morphology filters, manual markers, counts, CFU intervals, blue/white classification, batch mode). Explain the shared sample vocabulary they use.

pages.title: Image Annotator and Reproducibility Bundles
pages.purpose: Document src/lib/tools/annotate/ (multi-panel layout, annotations, scale bars, channels, profiles, export) and src/lib/repro/ plus shared/zipExport.ts (ZIP writing, SHA-256 manifest, parameters, methods text). Explain how every bench tool writes a self-describing reproducibility bundle.

pages.title: Phylogenetic Tree Tools
pages.purpose: Document src/lib/tools/tree/: Newick parsing and quoting rules, phylogram/cladogram/circular layouts, support values, ladderize/root/collapse operations, metadata joins, search and path highlighting, support histograms, Robinson-Foulds comparison, and SVG/PNG/project export. Trace the pure functions in newick.ts, layout.ts, treeops.ts, and compare.ts.

pages.title: SPD Integration and Publishing
pages.purpose: Document src/lib/spd/ and src-tauri/src/spd.rs: the Universal API Token flow, base URL normalization, request and response envelopes, the desktop HTTP bridge and its CORS rationale, gene and vector publish/load paths, artifact uploads, graph-DSL queries, restriction-enzyme sync, and the SPD inspector UI. Also document src/lib/gene/SpdGenePanel.svelte and Settings connection verification.

pages.title: Testing and E2E Harness
pages.purpose: Document the quality gates: Vitest suites under tests/ for scientific math and interchange formats, the WebdriverIO desktop harness under e2e/ with its Tauri service, static SPD mock in e2e/spdMock.js, fixtures, and shared helpers, plus the commands pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm build, and pnpm e2e. Explain what each gate covers and how the packaged binary is built for E2E.

pages.title: Build, Release, and CI
pages.purpose: Document the build and release pipeline: package.json scripts, Tauri configuration in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json and tauri.e2e.conf.json, Cargo dependencies and patches, the webdriver feature, icon sync and Android landscape scripts, and the GitHub workflows under .github/workflows/. Include the version bump locations and the platform bundle outputs.
